title: Installment 1 Amount — Payments Computation Standard
content:
# Installment 1 — payments computation standard

**Clause.** Installment 1 of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category collects the whole stay: the nightly subtotal and the cleaning, pet and extra-guest fees, plus a guest service fee of 14.20 percent of those amounts and occupancy tax at the percentage rate the occupancy tax schedule of the booking terms sets for the stay's jurisdiction, applied to those same amounts. The fee and the tax are each rounded half up to the cent, and installment 1 is the sum of those amounts, the fee and the tax, less the Roamhaven Rewards credits redeemed on the stay and not yet reinstated, taken to the cent.

- **Amounts** — the nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee and extra-guest fee in the stay's price breakdown.
- **Jurisdiction** — the one recorded on the stay.
- **Credits not yet reinstated** — the credits redeemed on the stay less those reinstated on it, in the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger, never less than zero.

## Percentage rate by jurisdiction

| Jurisdiction | Percentage rate |
|---|---|
| TX-AUSTIN | 17.00% |
| FL-ORANGE | 12.50% |
| CO-DENVER | 15.75% |
| TN-NASHVILLE | 15.25% |
| HI-HONOLULU | 17.96% |
| CA-SAN-DIEGO | 12.50% |

## Worked figure (hypothetical 5-night stay in CA-SAN-DIEGO)

| Item | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Nightly subtotal | — | 1,000.00 |
| Cleaning fee | — | 100.00 |
| Pet fee | — | 0.00 |
| Extra-guest fee | — | 50.00 |
| Amounts carried | sum of the four | 1,150.00 |
| Guest service fee | 14.20% of 1,150.00 | 163.30 |
| Occupancy tax | 12.50% of 1,150.00 | 143.75 |
| Credits redeemed and not reinstated | none | 0.00 |
| Installment 1 | 1,150.00 plus 163.30 plus 143.75 | 1,457.05 |

With 200.00 of Roamhaven Rewards credits redeemed on the stay and none reinstated, installment 1 would be 1,257.05; with 200.00 redeemed and 200.00 reinstated, 1,457.05.
